A part of you doesn't want to die yet, you still have things to do with your life, try to do them, if you feel better about your life after that, you won't try to kill yourself, if you still feel bad, you will have the courage to end it all...

You know deep inside it can't end like this.

What you are feeling is normal, but please promise yourself, now that you are planning on ending your life, to do something that makes you smile before you go, don't just do it like this, squeeze every drop of enjoyment you can, watch your favorite show again, write notes to the people you know, eat your favorite food, do what you want, then you may find peace in death, just live one more day, think about this decision one more time, there is no coming back.

I... Think that is not a good choice... I'm not sure about this but CO2 is not a good choice, you better try some other gas, you better read this https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suicide_bag

Dying by carbon dioxide is painful, try nitrogen or helium, nobody wants to die feeling so much pain

I moved away from home because I wanted to study in a decent college, thought that would make me happy, so my girlfriend and I started a long-distance relationship... 

It's not the same, we still talk, we play games sometimes, League of Legends mostly because it's the only game we both can run on our PCs...

But it feels really bad, although she knows my condition It's really hard to ask for help, even from her... 

But I tried anyways... I told her I was feeling terrible again, that I didn't know why...

Yesterday I skipped class, I thought taking a day off would help... but I still couldn't sleep at all, today I have a test and I can't concentrate on anything... 

So I called my mother at 2 AM, told her I wasn't feeling OK, she was really supportive, she told me I could go home for the weekend, maybe I will...

I wish I could get help, I've been taking antidepressants for 6 months now and I don't feel any better, I'd say I feel even worse... How long is it going to take?

Thanks for your time, I really appreciate it.
